resources.string:
This service records the coordinates and timing of taps, long presses and swipes on the screen only while you have pressed Record, and performs the same actions again when you press Play.

[Features used]
• Performing gestures (to replay recorded actions and to pass your touches through to the app underneath while recording)
• Buttons shown on top of the screen (Record, Play, Stop)

[How your data is handled]
• Only finger positions (coordinates) and timing are recorded. The content, text, passwords and personal information of other apps are never read.
• Recorded macros are stored only inside this app on this device.
• Recorded macros (coordinates and timing) are never sent off the device.
• This build shows ads (Google AdMob) on the app's main screen and uses in-app purchases (Google Play), so it has the internet permission. Information needed for ads and purchases is processed by Google (see the privacy policy for details).
• You can delete macros at any time from the list in the app.
